verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SigNoz acting only as an MCP server: external agents such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot connect to SigNoz to query its data, and SigNoz publishes Agent Skills for coding assistants. Nothing shows SigNoz acting as an MCP client that lets users plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. Since an observability platform with AI features could plausibly ship such client support, this capability applies to the product but is unevidenced.
